description: Summary figure: pairwise identities, acyl-channel lining differences between zebrafish paralogs, and relative-rate test
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
VOL={'G':60,'A':89,'S':89,'C':109,'D':111,'P':113,'N':114,'T':116,'E':138,'V':140,'Q':144,'H':153,
     'M':163,'I':167,'L':167,'K':169,'R':174,'F':190,'Y':194,'W':228}
KD={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,'L':3.8,
    'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
T=pd.read_csv("channel_lining_crossmapped.csv")
T["dVol_b_minus_a"]=[VOL[b]-VOL[a] for a,b in zip(T.abhd10a_aa,T.abhd10b_aa)]
T["dKD_b_minus_a"]=[round(KD[b]-KD[a],1) for a,b in zip(T.abhd10a_aa,T.abhd10b_aa)]
T["sub_a_to_b"]=[f"{a}->{b}" for a,b in zip(T.abhd10a_aa,T.abhd10b_aa)]
diff=T[T.paralogs_differ].copy()
print("Channel-lining positions where abhd10a and abhd10b differ (mouse 6NY9 numbering as reference):")
print(diff[["mouse_pos","mouse_aa","human_aa","abhd10a_pos","abhd10a_aa","abhd10b_pos","abhd10b_aa",
            "sub_a_to_b","dist_SerOG","in_core","dVol_b_minus_a","dKD_b_minus_a"]].to_string(index=False))
diff.to_csv("channel_paralog_differences.csv",index=False)
print("\nconserved lining positions: %d / %d"%((~T.paralogs_differ).sum(),len(T)))

# ---- domain-wise identity: N-terminal targeting region vs AB-hydrolase core ----
ctx=json.load(open("struct_ctx.json")); ZB=ctx["ZB"]; ZA=ctx["ZA"]; HS=ctx["HS"]
D=json.load(open("cds.json"))
# use mapping: mouse 44-293 is the crystallised core; zebrafish b core starts ~ pos 37
# simpler: split each zebrafish seq at its own nucleophile-elbow-anchored core boundary via alignment to human chain 53-306
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16.5,5.0))

# Panel A: pairwise identity
P=pd.read_csv("pairwise_identity.csv")
P=P[~P.seq1.str.contains("Gg") & ~P.seq2.str.contains("Gg")]
labels=["abhd10a_Dr","abhd10b_Dr","ABHD10_Hs","Abhd10_Mm","abhd10_Xt","abhd10_Lc","abhd10_Cm"]
Mx=np.full((len(labels),len(labels)),np.nan)
for _,r in P.iterrows():
    if r.seq1 in labels and r.seq2 in labels:
        i,j=labels.index(r.seq1),labels.index(r.seq2); Mx[i,j]=Mx[j,i]=r.pct_identity
np.fill_diagonal(Mx,100)
ax=axes[0]; im=ax.imshow(Mx,cmap="viridis",vmin=55,vmax=100)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(labels))); ax.set_xticklabels(labels,rotation=45,ha="right",fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(labels))); ax.set_yticklabels(labels,fontsize=8)
for i in range(len(labels)):
    for j in range(len(labels)):
        ax.text(j,i,"%.0f"%Mx[i,j],ha="center",va="center",
                color="white" if Mx[i,j]<85 else "black",fontsize=8)
ax.set_title("A  Global pairwise identity (%)\nNeedleman-Wunsch, BLOSUM62, gap -11/-1",fontsize=10)
plt.colorbar(im,ax=ax,fraction=0.046)

# Panel B: channel lining
ax=axes[1]
y=np.arange(len(T)); Ts=T.sort_values("dist_SerOG").reset_index(drop=True)
cols=["#c44e52" if d else "#cfcfcf" for d in Ts.paralogs_differ]
ax.barh(np.arange(len(Ts)), Ts.dist_SerOG, color=cols)
lab=["%s%d / %s%d"%(a,ap,b,bp) for a,ap,b,bp in zip(Ts.abhd10a_aa,Ts.abhd10a_pos,Ts.abhd10b_aa,Ts.abhd10b_pos)]
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(len(Ts))); ax.set_yticklabels(lab,fontsize=7)
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.set_xlabel("minimum distance to catalytic Ser OG in 6NY9 (A)")
ax.set_title("B  Acyl-channel lining residues\nred = abhd10a / abhd10b differ (8 of 27)",fontsize=10)

# Panel C: relative rate test
R=pd.read_csv("relative_rate_test_protein.csv")
ax=axes[2]; x=np.arange(len(R)); w=0.38
ax.bar(x-w/2,R.uniq_to_a,w,label="changes unique to abhd10a",color="#4c72b0")
ax.bar(x+w/2,R.uniq_to_b,w,label="changes unique to abhd10b",color="#dd8452")
for i,(m1,m2,p) in enumerate(zip(R.uniq_to_a,R.uniq_to_b,R.p)):
    ax.text(i,max(m1,m2)+1.0,"p = %.2f"%p,ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(R.outgroup,rotation=30,ha="right",fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("amino acid changes since duplication")
ax.set_title("C  Tajima relative-rate test\nno asymmetric rate in either direction",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.set_ylim(0,32)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
